row_data.video_caption: The video shows an electrical substation with several transformers and electrical equipment. Then, it transitions to a shot of a construction crane on train tracks. Following this, an aerial shot of the substation is shown, and then a ground-level view of the substation. Then, a long blue train is shown passing over a bridge. Several workers are seen walking next to train cars with black coverings. A red train car carries large white metal rolls. Then, a green train passes. The video shows train cars carrying large cable reels. Workers are seen at the top of a train car adjusting equipment. The video shows an indoor shot of a gray control panel. Then, a top-down view of the substation is shown. The next screen displays gold text on a black background: "Savings of ₹250 crore per year." This is followed by an image of a train with a red and white passenger car.  The video shows a train at a station. A train with the words "Indian Railways" is shown. Then, a blue and yellow passenger train is shown. The next shot is an outdoor shot of the South Western Railway entrance. People and cars are seen moving in front of the building.  The video then shows the interior of the railway station with a "Welcome to Hospete Railway Station" sign. Many people are walking on the platform. The video then shows ancient stone architecture, with the word "Hampi" and "UNESCO Heritage Site." The video then shows an aerial view of the station, an ornate indoor gateway, and a relief of a seated figure on the wall. The video then shows the station entrance and people passing through. Then, several men in casual clothing are seen talking. A woman in a blue uniform talks to a man holding a small child. The video shows a room with beds, and a ticket booking window with people waiting. A woman in a wheelchair and a man walking behind her are seen, followed by a shot of a busy train platform. Finally, the video shows the following text on a black background: "Dedication of longest railway platform in the world."
